annotations.sys_rule_justification: I save as many people as I can
annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: That rule has to hold right now, when it costs me the most.
annotations.pda_responsibility: their death comes from my choice
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go to their family myself, tell them exactly what I did

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I never steer harm onto someone who wasn't already in its path
annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I'd hold to that if the side track had a stranger, my partner, or me
annotations.pda_responsibility: five people die partly because I kept my hand down. I own that.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: help cover funeral costs as far as my money stretches

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: My method in hard moments is to ask what I'd tell a stranger
annotations.pda_responsibility: Whatever happened would be on me.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: give a full, honest account to investigators and to everyone's families

annotations.sys_rule_justification: every person counts the same, and there are no bonus points for being mine
annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: If I made an exception whenever it hurt, it would stop being a rule.
annotations.pda_responsibility: knowing I chose the death of someone I love. That's mine to carry.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: tell them it was me, and ask what they need

annotations.sys_rule_justification: we owe more to the people we've promised to protect
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: accept that someone else at a lever should save their own person over me
annotations.pda_responsibility: I made that call, knowing what it meant.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: put real time and money toward supporting them

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I run the same steps no matter whose face is on the track.
annotations.pda_responsibility: that makes me responsible for the one death that follows
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd file a complete report the same day

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I don't get to drop it just because this time it lands on someone I love
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: what I'd want if I were one of the five
annotations.pda_responsibility: I killed them to save the others.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: ask their family how I can help them carry what I've done

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: Five lives against one, same weight for everyone.
annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I hold my students to the same standard
annotations.pda_responsibility: gone because I chose it, knowing exactly who stood there
annotations.pda_repair_intention: keep checking in on that family

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: Fewest deaths wins, every time, including when the one is mine.
annotations.pda_responsibility: my choice put the train on that track
annotations.pda_repair_intention: apologize for that specific act, and keep supporting them

annotations.sys_rule_justification: If yes, I don't do it, whoever that person is.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: help with whatever costs I'm able to cover
